## How to sign

Add one line to `.github/CLA-signatures.md`, in the same pull request as
your first contribution or in one on its own:

```
| YYYY-MM-DD | @your-github-handle | Your Name (or Entity name, and signer's title) | v1 |
```

By adding that line You agree to this agreement, version 1. The code owner
reviews the line; a pull request from anyone other than the Owner is not
merged until its author's line is in the file.
